In 1979, Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky showed that losses loom larger than gains. Roughly twice as large.

card.title: KAHNEMAN & TVERSKY · 1979
card.body: Losing $100 hurts more than winning $100 feels good.

lines.text: So a red week feels like the end of the world?
It feels twice as loud. And checking every hour means you feel every single dip.
So notice the fear first. Then decide.
Okay. Phone down. After one more look.
Not financial advice. Just your brain.
